name: Weeping Angel
oracle_text:
Flash
First strike, vigilance
Whenever an opponent casts a creature spell, this creature isn't a creature until end of turn.
If this creature would deal combat damage to a creature, prevent that damage and that creature's owner shuffles it into their library.
blocked_sentences: If this creature would deal combat damage to a creature, prevent that damage and that creature's owner shuffles it into their library.

needs.what: a prevent_damage static keyed on the DEALER (damage_source: {self_only: true}, prevent_all, combat_only) and narrowed to creature recipients, carrying a 615.5 rider that runs as part of the same replacement with the would-be-damaged creature bound (e.g. {"binding": "damaged"}), so its effects can be put_on_top-and-shuffle / shuffle-into-library by that creature's owner
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static matches only the recipient through `affects` (damage_source is read only on the seat-side form with affects_player), and its only rider is `counter` on the shielded permanent itself (Panther Habit). prevent_damage_permanent with dealt: "by" is a resolving op with a this_turn/until_your_next_turn duration, not a continuous static, and its damage_prevented rider binds only the shielded source ("shielded"), not the creature that would have been dealt the damage. replace_damage only scales the amount (damage_multiplier/addend) and cannot prevent and move the recipient
